crossRefs.note: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was…
So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
For the law produces wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
For the law produces wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and…
The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

translations.web: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
translations.bsb: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
translations.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
translations.asv: but sin, finding occasion, wrought in me through the commandment all manner of coveting: for apart from the law sin is dead.
